text: Implemented prepared stencil scheduling specializations for spatialAxes=1 line passes and D2/D3 spatial passes, with cached offsets/origins and arbitrary-layout stride-aware addressing; generic fallback remains for other ranks and mutable Boolean multi-pass cases. Added Boolean reducer terminal contract and image4s dilation short-circuit. Ravel stencil JVM compile and 21 tests pass; Scala.js stencil compile passes. Image4s local-Ravel final parity receipt passes all 10 cases; cross-shape and allocation courts pass.
